repo.description:
### Summary

An authenticated request with incomplete input could make a background metadata query fail outside the request's error handling, and the resulting unhandled promise rejection terminated the NocoDB server process.

### Details

`MetaService` in `meta.service.ts` logged the SQL of each metadata read through the async `logHelper`, which the read methods called without awaiting. When a request left a lookup condition `undefined`, compiling the query for the log line threw knex's undefined-binding error. The request itself failed with an HTTP 500, but the rejection from the detached logging call was never handled, and the process exited through `handleUncaughtErrors` in `processUtils.ts` or through Node's default handling of unhandled rejections. The fix catches errors raised while building the log line.

### Impact

An authenticated user could stop the whole instance with a single request, and it stayed down until a supervisor or an operator restarted it. Anonymous requests could not trigger it.

### Credit

This issue was reported by [@5255fgh](https://github.com/5255fgh) (白墨).
repo.summary: Denial of Service via Unhandled Metadata Query Error
